answer_card.title: Run a module inside a virtual environment
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- block:
    - name: Ensure the venv exists
      ansible.builtin.pip:
        name: psutil
        virtualenv: "{{ venv_dir }}"
        virtualenv_command: "{{ ansible_python_interpreter }} -m venv"
    - name: Use it
      ansible.builtin.wait_for:
        port: 22
      vars:
        ansible_python_interpreter: "{{ venv_dir }}/bin/python"
  vars:
    venv_dir: /opt/myvenv
```

On Debian-based systems install the matching `python*-venv` package first.
